production.metric: hourly AC kWh per installed kWp (MAE ≈ 0.018 on held-out test)
production.data_range: Deploy artifact: full available PVGIS history, no holdout. Metrics below are from the model-selection run only (hold-out year 2023).
production.note: Metrics are from compare_production_models.py's hold-out evaluation that selected LightGBM over Ridge/RandomForest/XGBoost/v0-physical (see docs/research/PRODUCTION_MODEL_COMPARISON.md). The deployed artifact itself is retrained on full history without a held-out test, so these numbers describe why this model type was chosen, not a live self-test of this exact binary. If production_v1_lgbm.txt is absent or lightgbm isn't installed, backend/app/tools/production.py falls back to the v1-weather-regressor linear/physical blend automatically.

consumption.metric: 24-hour normalized load shape (RMSE ≈ 0.005 vs. TEDAŞ reference profiles)
consumption.data_source: Kaggle London Smart Meter (5500 households) calibrated with EPİAŞ 2024 Turkey hourly consumption ratios
consumption.data_range: 19,624 hourly records. Metrics below are from a separate comparison run (evaluate_advanced_consumption.py), not the deploy script's own train/test split.
consumption.note: See docs/research/CONSUMPTION_MODEL_COMPARISON.md. train_consumption_model.py (the deploy script) computes its own MAE/RMSE/R2 at train time but currently only prints them — they are not persisted, so they can't be reproduced here without re-running training.

optimizer.metric: daily TL cost minimization (greedy + 3-pass coordinate descent, interruptible-aware)
optimizer.data_source: EPDK regulated tariff tables (April 2026) + hourly net-metering regulation (May 2026)
optimizer.note: Deterministic device + battery scheduler. Saving computed as cost delta vs. habit-hour reference (±25% uncertainty range).
